C0414.title: Google Disrupts Large-Scale Phishing Campaign: Session Cookie Theft Bypasses MFA
C0414.summary: Google's Threat Analysis Group disclosed that a group of Russian-speaking hackers has been sending phishing emails to distribute malware and steal browser session cookies since late 2019. Even with multi-factor authentication enabled, attackers can hijack accounts using the stolen session cookies, bypassing MFA protection.
